court: High Court of Judicature at Bombay
case_name: Mrs. Suvarna Prashant Salve vs Mr. Prashant Pandit Salve

parties.petitioner_plaintiff: Wife (under section 24 of the Code of Civil Procedure, 1908)
parties.respondent_defendant: Husband (filed Marriage Petition No.502/2018 under section 13(1)(ia)(ib) of the Hindu Marriage Act, 1955)

acts_cited_auto: Protection of Women from DV Act, 2005

acts_cited.act: Protection of Women from DV Act, 2005

facts_of_case: Wife seeks transfer of marriage petition filed by husband for divorce from Family Court at Nasik to Family Court at Bandra, Mumbai. Husband has not paid maintenance amount due to wife.

legal_principles.principle: The burden lies on the applicant to establish hardship in seeking transfer of a case.
legal_principles.held: He submits that though the Trial Court has passed order u/s.125 Cr.P.C. and in the proceedings filed under the Protection of Women from Domestic Violence Act, 2005, the Respondent has failed to pay the maintenance to the Applicant to the tune of Rs.7,59,200/-.

legal_principles.principle: A court may transfer a case to another court if the applicant establishes hardship in seeking justice.
legal_principles.held: Therefore, this is a fit case to transfer the said marriage petition to the Family Court at Mumbai from Family Court at Nasik.

outcome.final_order: Transfer of marriage petition granted to Family Court at Bandra, Mumbai.
